facts.title: The Story Behind DAPT (chemical)
facts.fact: DAPT is a chemical compound used in the study of the Notch signaling pathway. DAPT is a γ-secretase inhibitor. It indirectly inhibits Notch, which is a substrate for γ-secretase.

vocab.definition: The strange wistfulness and rich atmosphere of used bookstores, filled with thousands of old books you may never have time to read.
vocab.example: Walking into the quiet corner of the central library before semester exams gave everyone a sudden sense of vellichor.
vocab.etymology: Coined by John Koenig in The Dictionary of Obscure Sorrows, blending 'vellum' (parchment) and 'ichor' (ethereal fluid).

vocab.definition: Having a ready insight into and sharp understanding of subtle things; mentally discerning and perceptive.
vocab.example: Her perspicacious critique during the SOLE literary debate uncovered the hidden irony in the author's final chapter.
vocab.etymology: From Latin 'perspicax' meaning 'sharp-sighted', from 'perspicere' (to look closely into).
